title: Memory-Efficient & Orthogonalized Optimizers Selection: FP32 AdamW vs. 8-Bit AdamW vs. GaLore/APOLLO vs. Distributed Muon (Newton-Schulz)

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Standard FP32 AdamW (4B Master Weight + 4B m_t + 4B v_t = 12 Bytes/Param)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Baseline when HBM and training compute budget are unconstrained

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Blockwise 8-Bit Quantized AdamW (4B Master + 1B m_t + 1B v_t = 6 Bytes/Param)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Drop-in 50% optimizer HBM & checkpoint size reduction for SFT/CPT

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Low-Rank Gradient Projection (GaLore / APOLLO Rank-1/8 = 2.4 Bytes/Param)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Full-parameter training on HBM-constrained nodes without LoRA rank freezes

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): Distributed Muon (Newton-Schulz Orthogonalized Momentum on 2D Weights + AdamW 1D)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Foundation pre-training & continual pre-training reaching target loss in 1.42x fewer tokens (-29.5% GPU hours!)
